_note: Reusable state for the Futures Console. Agents update this before rendering each issue. It is a near-term radar of events that could move SP-Index components, not a rumor dump.

radar.title: Codex migration promo: adoption proof window
radar.thesis: OpenAI's Codex enterprise promo is distribution signal today; it becomes curve signal only if uptake or usage-hours surface.
radar.trigger: OpenAI publishes enterprise promo approvals, seat counts, usage-hours, or a follow-up Codex product feature during the 30-day window.

radar.title: Unlimited-agent pricing breaks first
radar.thesis: The Anthropic/OpenAI exchange shows the next agent bottleneck is metering trust: long-running agents can consume thousands of requests where human chat consumes dozens.
radar.trigger: Either lab publishes new hard caps, enterprise-only pools, or a price change explicitly tied to automated coding agents.

radar.title: Google I/O: Gemini Omni / Gemini 4 watch
radar.thesis: After Meta escalated compute and OpenAI escalated distribution, Google I/O needs a model, price, or agent-surface answer.
radar.trigger: Named Gemini release, benchmark table, model card, or public product surface with a clear ship date.

radar.title: Figure F.03 endurance evidence
